subject: Tom Brady leaves Birmingham City ownership role as club tops Championship
title: Brady leaves, Birmingham go top

lines.vo: Tom Brady leaves Birmingham, and Birmingham go top. Coincidence?
lines.footage: Tom Brady Birmingham City St Andrew's, stadium exterior

lines.vo: Birmingham beat Swansea two-one, and lead the Championship with twenty-nine points from fifteen games.
lines.footage: Birmingham City Swansea highlights, two-one win

lines.vo: Seven wins from nine. Some managers would frame that.
Brady held three point three percent of the club. The most famous three point three percent in English football.
lines.footage: Brady on the touchline or in the stands, Birmingham

lines.vo: He chaired a new advisory board from August twenty twenty-three. Three years of very important meetings.
lines.footage: Tom Brady Birmingham City minority owner clip

lines.vo: During that time, Wayne Rooney was hired and sacked eighty-three days later. Shorter than most box sets.
Last summer they also paid a record fifteen million pounds for Jay Stansfield.
lines.footage: Jay Stansfield Birmingham goals and signing clip

lines.vo: Now Brady leaves, the club gives no reason, and the table still says first. Football's timing is wicked.
lines.footage: Birmingham fans celebrating at St Andrew's

lines.vo: Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: A cartoon investor in a sports jacket walks out through a stadium door carrying a tiny slice of pie. Gag: behind him a league table board flips and the home team slides up to the top. Twist: he looks back, puzzled, and the pie slice is wearing sunglasses.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon investor in a sports jacket

inserts.story: A giant pie chart sits on a boardroom table with a tiny sliver of 3.3 percent. Gag: the sliver stands up, puts on a tiny hat and bows. Twist: the rest of the chart applauds with little hands.

A cartoon chairman pushes a wheelbarrow of coins toward a young striker with a record-breaking price tag. Gag: the coins pile higher than the chairman. Twist: the striker waves and the pile of coins turns into a tower of golden balls.

facts_used: Brady left Birmingham minority ownership role after three years; club gave no reason (ev0111)
Birmingham top the Championship with 29 points from 15 matches after a 2-1 win over Swansea; seven wins from nine (ev0111)
Club spent heavily last summer, including a record 15 million pound deal for Jay Stansfield (ev0111)
Brady held a 3.3 percent stake and chaired a new advisory board from August 2023 (ev0111)
Wayne Rooney hired and sacked 83 days later during Brady's time (ev0111 background)
